# BactoAI

> BactoAI is a genomic AI engine that predicts antimicrobial resistance from bacterial whole-genome sequences in minutes, supporting faster precision treatment decisions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bactoai.lovable.app/): Overview, live demo, and validation.
- [Technology](https://bactoai.lovable.app/technology): How the prediction engine works, features, and FAQ.
- [Research](https://bactoai.lovable.app/research): Research, impact, and partner laboratories.
- [About](https://bactoai.lovable.app/about): Team, media coverage, partners, and roadmap.
- [Pricing](https://bactoai.lovable.app/pricing): Research and clinical plans.
- [Press](https://bactoai.lovable.app/press): Media coverage and press kit.
- [Resources](https://bactoai.lovable.app/resources): Guides and articles.
- [Blog](https://bactoai.lovable.app/blog): News and insights.
- [Contact](https://bactoai.lovable.app/contact): Request a demo or pilot.
